title: The Ark Meets Ananya
summary: Decades on, the Ark halts at the Aravali valley. Varuna and Mithra find the Kelpfang-II's overgrown hull, the shrine, and Ananya, who remembers nothing of the old world. Her grown children give them the lenses and copper solar-coils kept on the shrine's altar, which light and purify the Ark's water for generations.
